description:
Port markdown.ts (852 LOC) — the single most impactful missing feature. Without this, all assistant messages are plain text.

Implement:
- Parse markdown (use Earmark or similar Elixir lib) into styled ANSI output
- Headings with color + bold
- Bold, italic, strikethrough, underline
- Code spans (inline) with background color
- Fenced code blocks with language label (syntax highlighting deferred)
- Blockquotes with left border
- Ordered/unordered lists with proper indentation
- Hyperlinks via OSC 8 escape sequences
- Width-aware line wrapping within each block
- Theme integration (MarkdownTheme colors from theme system)

Upstream: packages/tui/src/components/markdown.ts
title: Markdown renderer: headings, bold, italic, code, lists, links
